# Upstream: RFC 1950, RFC 1951, RFC 1952

- Source: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1950.txt, https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1951.txt, https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1952.txt
- Fetch date: 2026-09-26

Plain-text copies of the three RFCs this tool cites: RFC 1950 (ZLIB Compressed Data Format,
the wrapper the "deflate" CompressionFormat produces), RFC 1951 (DEFLATE Compressed Data Format,
the algorithm behind "deflate-raw") and RFC 1952 (GZIP file format specification, the wrapper the
"gzip" CompressionFormat produces).

Each RFC's own memo states: "This memo provides information for the Internet community. This
memo does not specify an Internet standard of any kind. Distribution of this memo is unlimited."
(quoted from the "Status of This Memo" section common to all three, e.g. RFC 1952 line 8-10).
